body_md:
The UK is a diverse society. Most people live in towns and cities. The currency is the **pound sterling**; Scotland and Northern Ireland also print their own banknotes.

English is spoken everywhere. Many people in Wales speak **Welsh**, and some people in Scotland speak **Gaelic**.

Men and women have equal rights. Women make up about half of the workforce.
key_facts: Welsh is widely spoken in Wales
Women make up about half of the workforce
